exact_query: curl -sL 'https://drive.switch.ch/index.php/s/j3WUOYXWgv9Jbnz/download' -o allfiles.tar.gz ; tar xzf allfiles.tar.gz A2029/<file>
extraction: Upstream FITS, byte-for-byte as shipped in allfiles.tar.gz. HDU1 'DENSITY' = n_e(r) in physical units (63 rows). HDU2 'SCALED_NE' = same profile scaled to R/R500 and self-similar density (63 rows). Companion TSV of HDU1 written alongside.
note: Abell 2029. Instrument: XMM-Newton EPIC (X-COP mosaic), Ghirardini et al. 2019 A&A 621, A41 / Eckert et al. X-COP. THIS IS A DEPROJECTED ELECTRON DENSITY PROFILE n_e(r), obtained by deprojecting the azimuthally-averaged X-ray surface brightness under an assumption of SPHERICAL SYMMETRY using the L1-penalty (multiscale) method. Radial range 2.26-2212.1 kpc = 0.0016-1.564 R500 (R500=1414.0 kpc). NO core excision: the innermost bin starts at 2.26 kpc. n_e is a MEASURED/deprojected quantity, not derived from a mass model.
